checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is cell_index properly validated within [0, CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB) before array access in coset_shift_for_cell?

reachability.notes: Attacker-controlled cell_index from P2P input. FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_CELL * cell_index could overflow or exceed array bounds.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. Identify all call sites to coset_shift_for_cell from P2P message handlers. 2. Trace the cell_index parameter back to P2P input source. 3. Verify that cell_index is validated to be in range [0, CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB) BEFORE the function call or at function entry. 4. Check for integer overflow in FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_CELL * cell_index computation (especially if cell_index is near max value). 5. Attempt to craft P2P messages with cell_index = CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB, cell_index = UINT_MAX, and cell_index = (UINT_MAX / FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_CELL) + 1. 6. Verify that malformed inputs are rejected at gossip validation layer before reaching coset_shift_for_cell. 7. Confirm assertion/bounds check fires before roots_brp array access.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0025, Trust Boundary: tb-002, Invariant: SG-016:INV-001, Threat: stride-017. Exploitation could crash validator node via memory corruption or out-of-bounds read.

checklist.title: Verify Integer Overflow Protection: Does FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_CELL * cell_index computation prevent overflow before array indexing?

reachability.notes: Attacker-controlled cell_index from P2P input. FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_CELL * cell_index could overflow or exceed array bounds.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. Determine the data type of cell_index and FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_CELL constants. 2. Calculate the maximum safe value: MAX_SAFE_INDEX = (TYPE_MAX / FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_CELL). 3. Verify that bounds check occurs BEFORE multiplication, not after. 4. Test with cell_index values that would cause multiplication overflow. 5. Confirm the assertion in coset_shift_for_cell catches this case.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0025, Supporting check for primary boundary integrity. Integer overflow could lead to smaller-than-expected index, accessing unintended memory.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is cell_index properly validated before coset retrieval in coset_for_cell?

reachability.notes: Same as PROP-0025 but for the full coset retrieval.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. Identify all call sites of coset_for_cell function (SG-017). 2. Verify that cell_index is validated to be in range [0, CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB) BEFORE being passed to the function. 3. Attempt to invoke coset_for_cell with cell_index = CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB (boundary value). 4. Attempt to invoke with cell_index = CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB + 1 and maximum uint value. 5. Verify the slice access roots_brp[start : start + FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_CELL] cannot exceed array bounds. 6. Calculate: start = cell_index * FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_CELL, verify start + FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_CELL <= len(roots_brp). 7. Check if panic/crash occurs or if bounds checking prevents out-of-bounds access. 8. Verify the returned Coset always contains exactly FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_CELL elements.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0026, Trust Boundary: tb-002, Invariant: SG-017:INV-001, Threat: stride-017. Out-of-bounds slice access causes crashes or returns incorrect coset elements. Attacker-controlled cell_index via P2P could trigger node crash.

checklist.title: Verify P2P Peer Input Sanitization: Are cell indices from P2P peers validated before reaching coset_for_cell?

reachability.notes: Same as PROP-0025 but for the full coset retrieval.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. Trace the data flow from P2P message receipt to coset_for_cell invocation. 2. Identify all validation layers between P2P input and the function call. 3. Verify that P2P gossip validation explicitly checks cell_index bounds. 4. Attempt to craft a malicious P2P message with out-of-bounds cell_index. 5. Verify the malicious message is rejected at the P2P layer before reaching coset_for_cell. 6. Check for any code paths that bypass P2P validation.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0026, Covers actor-p2p-peer. Malicious P2P peer could send crafted messages with invalid cell indices to crash validator nodes.

checklist.title: Verify Validator Node Resilience: Can a validator node be crashed by malformed coset requests?

reachability.notes: Same as PROP-0025 but for the full coset retrieval.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. Set up a test validator node with monitoring. 2. Send a series of coset requests with boundary and invalid cell_index values via P2P. 3. Monitor for panics, crashes, or unexpected behavior. 4. Verify that invalid requests result in graceful error handling, not crashes. 5. Check that the validator node remains operational after receiving malformed requests. 6. Test with cell_index values: -1 (if signed), 0, CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB-1, CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB, MAX_UINT.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0026, Covers actor-validator-node. A crash in coset_for_cell could be exploited to take down validator nodes, disrupting network consensus.
